risks.risk: Whether it is truly dual-suspension (rear shock) vs only front suspension
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear triangle showing the rear shock/hinge area (or a side view that shows rear suspension travel).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a front-suspension only mountain bike (worst case vs claimed dual suspension).

risks.risk: Whether it has dual disc brakes (rear disc) and that both brakes work
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear wheel hub/rotor and a short video of braking from both sides.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as single disc brake (front only) and assume rear brake may be missing/not working.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in one photo (bent rim, worn tires, loose headset, chain/cassette wear)
risks.proof: Video walk-around: check wheels for wobble, brakes/gear shifting while pedaling, and a close-up of chain/cassette teeth.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as used with possible wear (no premium for 'clean' condition).

risks.risk: Frame size and fit (affects value) not readable
risks.proof: Photo of the frame size marking (if any) and measurement from seat tube top to center of bottom bracket, plus seat height range.
risks.if_unproven: Price it without size premium (assume average/unknown fit).

proof_requests: Send a clear rear-side photo showing whether there is a rear shock/hinge (dual suspension confirmation).
Send a close-up of the rear brake rotor and caliper (dual disc confirmation).
Send a short video: braking test (front and rear) and gear shifting while pedaling.
Send close-ups of chain + cassette/freewheel teeth and tire tread/wear.
